title: cotoneaster rotundifolius var. uva-ursi
intro: Cotoneaster rotundifolius var. uva-ursi, commonly known as Uva-ursi, is a shrub-like plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating urinary tract infections, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Uva-ursi include its ability to astringent, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Uva-ursi include arbutin, hydroquinone, and various flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
